name: @singularity/plugin-framework-browser-server-demo
description: Demo packs for a browser server: definePack(({ ago }) => [packValue, packAll, packRows, packWindow …]) records typed answers to live declarations, parsed with each declaration's schema on load (DemoPackError naming the key and tuple); servePack(pack) turns them into the browser server's serve half — one external serveValue / serveCollection per declaration, `changes: { fixed }`, answering exactly the recorded tuples the client subscribes (canonical params; a window's query at any limit and page cut; :rows from every recorded row; :count) and throwing DemoMissingError for anything else. DemoScenario names a lazily-loaded pack.
